name: Simpact VC

entity_kind.quote: Simpact Ventures is the first VC investment fund in Poland based on the idea of Impact Investing.

investor_type.quote: Simpact Ventures is the first VC investment fund in Poland based on the idea of Impact Investing.

sectors.quote: It will provide sector agnostic investments with a preference for pre-seed, seed, and Series A investments (equity & convert).

stages.quote: It will provide sector agnostic investments with a preference for pre-seed, seed, and Series A investments (equity & convert).

ticket_min.quote: The tickets will range from nearly €100,000 (500,000 PLN) to over €2 million (10 million PLN), with strong follow-on strategy.

ticket_max.quote: We support founders from the early stages of development, offering ticket sizes of up to EUR 2 million.

aum.quote: The fund has over €21 million (100 million PLN) under management, dedicated to early-stage startups, mainly from CEE.

investments.quote: Fundusz Simpact Ventures stanął na czele rundy finansowania ForActive, w której startup pozyskał 3,6 mln dolarów.
TGS Baltic has advised Simpact Ventures on its investment in Ligence as part of a round that also saw the participation of Coinvest Capital

notes: Warsaw-based impact VC. AUM is the size of Fund II (Simpact 2.0, PLN 100M). Portfolio includes CulturePulse (US/Slovak, investment date December 2024 per simpact.vc), but no source explicitly confirming investment activity in Slovakia was found, so SK is not in active_in.
